definition: [ חִשָּׁבוֺן ] noun masculine device, invention (compare Lag BN 200 ) — only plural absolute חִשְּׁבֹנוֺת ; עָשָׁה הָאֱלֹהִים אֶתהָֿאָדָם יָשָׁר וְהֵמָּה בִקְשׁוּ חִשְּׁבֹנוֺת רַבִּים Eccl 7:29 God made mankind upright but they sought out many devices ; וַיַּעַשׂ חִשְּׁבֹנוֺת מַחֲשֶׁבֶת חֹוֺשֵׁב 2Chr 26:15 and he made contrivances (i.e. engines of war for hurling stones and arrows, see v b ) the invention of inventive men .

[חִשָּׁבוֺן] noun masculine device, invention (compare LagBN 200) — only plural absolute חִשְּׁבֹנוֺת; עָשָׁה הָאֱלֹהִים אֶתהָֿאָדָם יָשָׁר וְהֵמָּה בִקְשׁוּ חִשְּׁבֹנוֺת רַבִּים Eccl 7:29 God made mankind upright but they sought out many devices; וַיַּעַשׂ חִשְּׁבֹנוֺת מַחֲשֶׁבֶת חֹוֺשֵׁב 2Chr 26:15 and he made contrivances (i.e. engines of war for hurling stones and arrows, see vb) the invention of inventive men.
